_comment: T-1889. Which heavy trees each focused test module reads from its sandbox.
Absent module => the run copies EVERYTHING, exactly as before this file.
An entry of [] means the module reads only the source tree.
Only '.git' or '.saipen/<child>' may be named: anything narrower would
drop part of the tested subject, so the resolver refuses it.
NEVER add an entry from import analysis or an audit hook over another
module. Declare a module only after running it in a narrowed sandbox and
seeing its own assertions pass there; that run is the evidence.
